```yaml
name: PR Preview Docs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  deploy-pr-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.action != 'closed'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install mkdocs-material mike

      - name: Build docs
        run: |
          mkdocs build

      - name: Deploy to PR preview
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          BRANCH_NAME="gh-pages"
          
          # Clone gh-pages branch
          git clone https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git gh-pages
          cd gh-pages
          
          # Configure git
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          # Create PR preview directory
          mkdir -p "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
          
          # Copy built docs to PR preview directory
          cp -r ../site/* "pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
          
          # Add and commit changes
          git add "pr/${PR_NUMBER}/"
          git commit -m "Deploy PR #${PR_NUMBER} preview" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin ${BRANCH_NAME}

      - name: Get changed docs URLs
        id: changed-docs
        run: |
          # Get list of changed markdown files
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} | grep -E '\.md$' || true)
          
          if [ -n "$CHANGED_FILES" ]; then
            # Convert file paths to URLs (assuming docs are in docs/ directory)
            CHANGED_URLS=$(echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | sed 's|^docs/||' | sed 's|\.md$||' | while read -r file; do
              echo "- [${file}](https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/${file})"
            done)
            echo "changed_urls<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "$CHANGED_URLS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed_urls=" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post PR comment
        uses: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v2
        with:
          header: pr-preview
          message: |
            ## 📚 Documentation Preview
            
            Preview URL: https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/
            
            ${{ steps.changed-docs.outputs.changed_urls != '' && '### Changed Pages' || '' }}
            ${{ steps.changed-docs.outputs.changed_urls }}

  cleanup-pr-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.action == 'closed'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: gh-pages

      - name: Remove PR preview
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          
          # Configure git
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          # Remove PR preview directory if it exists
          if [ -d "pr/${PR_NUMBER}" ]; then
            rm -rf "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
            git add "pr/${PR_NUMBER}"
            git commit -m "Remove PR #${PR_NUMBER} preview"
            git push origin gh-pages
          else
            echo "No preview directory found for PR #${PR_NUMBER}"
          fi
```
